summary: Iteration 112: Verified new 'Загрузить КП' (Upload KP) flow inside ContractGenerationModal — backend endpoint + validation + attach + full frontend UI flow. All backend pytest cases (4/4) pass, and Playwright end-to-end flow verified: file upload via hidden input, KP prepended to list and auto-checked, selected-count increments (3→4), success toast shown, contract successfully generated with new KP attached.

issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' emitted by SaunaCRMPage — cosmetic, no functional impact.

action_items: (Optional) Fix missing React 'key' prop warning in SaunaCRMPage list render (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: upload_kp endpoint properly validates lead existence (404) and file extension (400) — good.
PDF stored in Mongo calculator_pdfs (works without Cloudinary). Consider adding a max-size guard to prevent large file uploads eating DB space.
Filename-based mime check only (endswith); attackers could name a non-PDF as .pdf. Consider magic-byte sniffing (e.g., check '%PDF' header) for stricter validation. Low priority.
handleUploadKp in ContractGenerationModal.jsx correctly prepends kp and auto-selects it — matches UX described.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded lead CRM-UP-TEST. Test uploads add extra KPU-* PDFs into db.calculator_pdfs and documents entries on that lead — safe to leave; can be cleaned if needed.
